repairs.quote: Smolder lets out an adorable flaming sneeze, dealing (60/70/80/90/100 + (60% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and Slowing by 35% for 1.5 seconds. Hitting champions causes an explosion, dealing (10/35/60/85/110 + (50% bonus Attack Damage) + (80% Ability Power)) physical + 0.55 magic damage. Each consecutive explosion does 75% damage. Smolder can only gain one Dragon Practice stack per champion hit.
